name: Werchter Parklife
description: One-day open air at Festivalpark Werchter with Foo Fighters
price: GA 136 EUR, pit 189 EUR (fees incl.); sale 20 Nov 10:00
note: Foo Fighters, Iggy Pop, The Hives
details: One-day open air by the Rock Werchter organisers on Saturday 19 June 2027, headlined by Foo Fighters on their Take Cover Tour. Also on the bill: Iggy Pop, The Hives, Violet Grohl, Florence Road, Alice Mae. Tickets via ticketmaster.be from Fri 20 Nov 2026 10:00 (Live Nation presale 19 Nov): general admission 136 EUR, pit 189 EUR (front area during Foo Fighters), Hideout packages 305 / 359 EUR with hospitality and parking; all prices include fees, mobility and eco contribution. Same weekend as Graspop (Dessel, 45 km).
